projects.title: Reddit Toxic User Detector
projects.description:
Created an application that states if a given user is toxic on Reddit.
Another part of the project was a web crawler that gathered Reddit accounts from front page posts and determined if those accounts had overall toxic behavior.

The project was created as part of Kent Hack Enough 2015 hackathon.
